reference_sql:
WITH moves AS (
  -- one row per movement event in 2025, in euros
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, e.event_type,
    e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS mrr_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_type <> 'opening'
    AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT month_start,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'new' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS new_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'expansion' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'reactivation' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS reactivation_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'contraction' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS contraction_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'churn' THEN mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS churn_mrr
FROM moves
GROUP BY month_start

WITH by_type AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 and movement type, in euros
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, e.event_type,
    SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS mrr_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_type <> 'opening'
    AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE), e.event_type
)
SELECT m.month_start,
  ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT x.mrr_eur FROM by_type x WHERE x.month_start = m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'new'), 0), 2) AS new_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT x.mrr_eur FROM by_type x WHERE x.month_start = m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'expansion'), 0), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT x.mrr_eur FROM by_type x WHERE x.month_start = m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'reactivation'), 0), 2) AS reactivation_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT x.mrr_eur FROM by_type x WHERE x.month_start = m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'contraction'), 0), 2) AS contraction_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT x.mrr_eur FROM by_type x WHERE x.month_start = m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'churn'), 0), 2) AS churn_mrr
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT month_start FROM by_type) AS m

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (SELECT e.account_id, a.segment, e.event_type, e.event_date, s.currency, e.mrr_delta_local AS d, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS eur
  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(eur) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'new'), 0), 2) AS new_mrr, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(eur) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'expansion'), 0), 2) AS expansion_mrr, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(eur) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'reactivation'), 0), 2) AS reactivation_mrr, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(eur) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'contraction'), 0), 2) AS contraction_mrr, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(eur) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'churn'), 0), 2) AS churn_mrr FROM ev WHERE event_type <> 'opening' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1
